metadata.datasource: Agfa Datenblatt APX 100, status 08/1995, 1st edition; SHA256 7a016ede883a7a76999c285c6eceb3db53b13613329286750b31a06000f133a6. Reproduce with scripts/bw_expansion/prepare_bw_film.py; axis calibration derived from the page by scripts/bw_expansion/extract_graphs.py; source points, assumptions and conditions: data/profile-sources/agfa-apx100/recipe.json. PCHIP of the single plotted log-sensitivity trace; engine covers 380-780 nm. The trace spans 380.42-662.45 nm and meets the panel's floor at 662.0 nm, so it is truncated at 660 nm; 380 nm is left unmeasured because the trace begins above it. Both are explicit unmeasured-tail approximations, not proof of zero sensitivity. The sheet does not label the density curve with a developer or time, and its gradient does not match recommended development. Measured average gradient is 0.567 over 1.3 decades and 0.598 over 1.5, from the point 0.1 above base. The sheet's own gamma-time curves read about 0.650 at every recommended 20 C time (Refinal 6, Rodinal 1+25 8, Rodinal 1+50 17, Rodinal Special 4, Studional 4). Reading those curves back at 0.598 gives 3.4, 4.4, 6.1 and 14.4 minutes - consistently about 0.8 of the recommended time on all four. So the panel shows less than recommended development; the exact conditions are not stated and cannot be recovered. 6 minutes is recorded as a nominal label only.
